# Draft:Miss Grand Dominican Republic 2026

Miss Grand Dominican Republic 2026 will be the 4th edition of the Miss Grand Dominican Republic pageant, to be held on 4 July 2026 at the Teatro La Fiesta, Hotel Jaragua, Santo Domingo. The winner of the contest will represent the country at the Miss Grand International 2026 in India in October the same year.
Selection of contestants
In addition to the central recruitment conducted by the national organizer, the authority to select and appoint local representatives was also delegated to regional organizers, who could determine their representatives either through direct appointment or by organizing local pageants. However, for this year’s edition of Miss Grand Dominican Republic, only one local pageant was organized to select the contestants, detailed as follows.
